text:
Which statement about the extraction of aluminium by electrolysis is correct?
A
Aluminium oxide is dissolved in molten cryolite to increase its melting point.
B
At the cathode, oxygen ions lose electrons to form oxygen gas.
C
The carbon in the graphite anode reacts with oxygen gas forming carbon dioxide.
The reaction at the anode is Al3+  +  3e–→  Al.
D

options.label: A
options.text: Aluminium oxide is dissolved in molten cryolite to increase its melting point.

options.label: B
options.text: At the cathode, oxygen ions lose electrons to form oxygen gas.

options.label: C
options.text: The carbon in the graphite anode reacts with oxygen gas forming carbon dioxide.

options.label: D
options.text: The reaction at the anode is Al3+  +  3e–→  Al.
